independence: Reviewer authored no evaluated implementation, scientific estimator, manuscript, figure source or conclusion. Only QA scripts, derivative QA raster images, contact sheets and this review were written. Local team review, not external peer review or independent numerical/model replication.
scope: Actual final production R18 PDF, complete 111 PNG/SVG figure pairs, main and gallery HTML static readability/link/assets; no new experiment, reserve-outcome access, model/API call, training or numerical replay.
limitations: No independent numerical replication, model rerun, CSV value verification or new scientific validity assessment by this reviewer; /root/reset_critic owns the separate numerical/replay/package review.

No browser-rendered HTML screenshots: during attempt-1 review, CUA denied file:/// access because only http/https protocols are allowed and explicitly prohibited workarounds. Browser work stopped; no local server or alternate browser route was used. Final HTML received safer static parser/CSS/local-filesystem checks. Visual overviews provide broad layout coverage rather than proof of every number or every possible font renderer. Five repaired figure pairs and every final PDF page received individual detailed views; unchanged prior individual figure views are explicitly identified.

N/A text-box estimates use exact DejaVu glyph metrics and actual SVG coordinates; this is geometry QA, not an independent rendering-engine coverage guarantee or scientific experiment.
